India loses 4-0 to Brazil in football match

The Indian men's football team lost to Brazil with a score of 4-0. Brazil's goals were scored by Samuel Lino (two goals) and Estevao Willian (two goals). The match was described as a "big day" for India, where they "showed spark" and "created some chances" but were ultimately "a cut above" by the five-time football world champions.
